questions.q: What term does Wilding use for the addiction to achievement?
questions.why: She calls the addiction to validation the Honor Roll Hangover.

questions.q: How does Wilding define a sensitive striver?
a: Highly emotional, deeply empathetic, not necessarily a perfectionist
questions.why: Sensitive strivers feel emotions deeply and are more empathic.

questions.q: What is the first step in Wilding's three‑phase process?
questions.why: She states knowing where you stand is the first step.

questions.q: Which feeling does Wilding link to overthinking?
a: Analyzing repeatedly and reaching false conclusions
questions.why: Overthinkers analyze repeatedly and often miss truth.

questions.q: What consequence does the Honor Roll Hangover have on inner peace?
questions.why: She notes it can cost you your inner peace.
